-How to add checkpoints:

See that big script with many 'create checkpoint' blocks? Just add an if statement that checks if the cup and track variables are equal to the track you want to add checkpoints to and start placing down 'create checkpoint' blocks inside it. You can set the position and angle of each checkpoint and the game will calculate everything else for you

If you want to see your checkpoint to ensure they've been place correctly, press Q while racing to show them.

To update the checkpoints after making changes, just re-enter the race.

Don't worry about remaking checkpoints for mirror or reverse variations of tracks. The game will convert them for you.

-Guidelines (IMPORTANT):

When visible, each checkpoint should go up a colour of the rainbow further through the track. Make sure the order of the checkpoints is correct!

Make sure you are positioning checkpoints in regular mode, not mirror or reverse mode.

Make sure it isn't possible to drive past checkpoints or else the lap might not count. You can add walls to the sides of the checkpoint to ensure this.

Checkpoints have to be relatively close to each other (use MK Stadium for reference). This is required to make Lakitu correctly track your direction and could be useful for respawning.

Make sure the arrow on the checkpoints point in the direction you're suppose to drive in. Again, this won't cause bugs, but it would make implementing respawning easier.
